title: AI, Governance, and the Future of Finance
summary: Vertex is the leading and most-trusted provider of comprehensive, integrated tax technology solutions, having helped 10,000+ businesses since 1978.
body_markdown:
### Governments are moving closer to the transaction.


Tax authorities increasingly expect real-time visibility, so trusted data and clear controls are now a finance priority.


### Design tax in from the start.


ERP modernization is the moment to build tax into the architecture, not bolt it on later.


### E-invoicing is more than a mandate.


Compliance requirements can also drive cleaner data and stronger processes across the business.


### Build the intelligent tax function.


AI works best when it adds tax-specific context, explainable outputs, and human-in-the-loop control to the workflow.


### AI strengthens expertise. It doesn't replace accountability.


Governance, cost discipline, and clear ownership are what let AI scale responsibly.


### Move from alignment to execution.


Start with a focused use case and clear ownership, then use the next 90 days to turn strategy into action.
